svg.text: UV trim loops — a face is a bounded patch of an UNBOUNDED surface; this is that boundary, drawn in the surface’s own chart
Kernel-only lane: no camera, no projection, no silhouettes, no external renderer. Compare renders/montage.png (our tessellation) and renders-freecad/montage-freecad.png (OCC’s).
67 cell(s) = one representative per (body, chart) + every failed walk; 315 further curved and 946 planar face(s) not shown (all 1328 are in out/uv/)
isoline — the exact u/v-const image (NURBS walls)
dashed, in the form’s own color — pcurve DERIVED, not cached
fitted — the rung-3 SSI-trace chart projection
dot — a loop junction; arrow — traversal direction
